role: Predeclared next study: dense conditional-return supervision for SAME three-class target; no fit yet
motivation: Three-family categorical comparison shows weak outer generalization; hard class labels discard magnitude within each class. Test continuous future-return supervision without redefining evaluation labels.
target: Evaluation remains VNINDEX T+20 return strictly below -5%, above +5%, else sideway, same1560 dates.
features: Same original19 close/ETF/trend; no additional source or universe
regression_targets: future log return / (trailing20 daily log-return sample std * sqrt20)
normalization_formula: Z=log(P[t+20]/P[t]) / (std(last20 completed daily log returns,ddof=1)*sqrt20); only past sigma enters normalizer.
forecast_map: Fit one conditional quantile per level, sort predicted quantiles, convert normalized predictions back to log returns. Quadrature class mass = sum fixed atom weights with return < log(.95), > log(1.05), otherwise sideway. Threshold equality stays sideway.
decision_rules: argmax mass / mature-training class frequency; decision balancing only, not calibrated posterior
timing: All training labels must mature strictly before global prediction/refit boundary. Raw-calendar labels and sigma before any feature filter.
acceptance: Compare same dates/labels vs original trend and risk controls: +.02 mean fold F1, no worse worst F1, MCC gain, >=3 improved folds. No independent acceptance from repeatedly inspected history.
limitations: Quantile quadrature probabilities are approximate scores, not asserted calibrated event probabilities.
Previous quantile risk study used onlyq10 for binary risk; this study requires the full three-class distribution and fixed target.
No confidence subset, label policy change or automatic deployment.
